# Overview

This document describes the structure of the Julia source in the `Wflow/src` folder, starting from the BMI adapter in [Wflow/src/bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L1-L120). It highlights key types, modules, files, and relationships to help developers navigate the codebase.

**Scope**: files under `Wflow/src` that implement configuration, model composition, IO, domain/routing, land models, and the BMI adapter.

**Primary entry points**:
- Top-level module: [Wflow/src/Wflow.jl](Wflow/src/Wflow.jl#L1-L120) — defines `Model`, includes submodules and orchestrates `run` and the timestep loop.
- BMI adapter: [Wflow/src/bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L1-L120) — exposes Basic Model Interface functions to external couplers.


## 1. BMI adapter (starting point)

See [Wflow/src/bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L1-L120) for the implementation. Key responsibilities:

- Initialization and lifecycle
  - `BMI.initialize(::Type{<:Model}, config_file)` — builds `Config`, chooses model type, constructs `Model`, and loads fixed forcing. See [bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L1-L120).
  - `BMI.finalize(model)` — writes remaining state, resets clock, and closes files. See [bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L1-L120).

- Time-stepping helpers
  - `BMI.update`, `BMI.update_until` — call internal `run_timestep!` and manage multi-step advances. See [bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L1-L120) and related `run_timestep!` in [Wflow/src/Wflow.jl](Wflow/src/Wflow.jl#L200-L320).

- Variable and grid interface
  - `BMI.get_input_var_names`, `BMI.get_output_var_names` — derive exchange variables from the `API` TOML section and standard-name metadata. See [bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L40-L120).
  - `BMI.get_value_ptr`, `BMI.get_value`, `BMI.set_value`, `BMI.get_value_at_indices`, `BMI.set_value_at_indices` — map BMI variable names to internals via property lenses and domain active indices. See [bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L120-L320).
  - Grid functions: `BMI.get_grid_x`, `BMI.get_grid_y`, `BMI.get_grid_node_count`, `BMI.get_grid_edge_nodes`, `BMI.get_grid_edge_count` — map internal `domain` and `network` structures to BMI grid concepts. See [bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L300-L600).

- State I/O helpers
  - `load_state`, `save_state`, `get_start_unix_time` — helpers to persist/restore simulation state for couplers. See [bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L520-L680).

- Utility helpers
  - `soil_layer_standard_name(name::String)` — parse layered soil variable names.
  - `grid_element_type(...)` — map variables/lenses to `node`/`edge` element types. See [bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L600-L800).


## 2. Core model composition

- [Wflow/src/Wflow.jl](Wflow/src/Wflow.jl#L1-L120)
  - Declares `Model{R,L,M,W,T}` composite type that aggregates configuration (`Config`), `Domain`, `Routing`, `Land` model, `MassBalance`, `Clock`, `NCReader` (reader), `Writer` and `ModelType` (type`).
  - Provides constructors: `Model(config)` and `Model(config, type)` used by `BMI.initialize` and `run(config)`.
  - Orchestrates the main loop: `run!`, `run_timestep!`, `run_timestep!(model; update_func=update_model!)` — see [Wflow/src/Wflow.jl](Wflow/src/Wflow.jl#L200-L360).

- Configuration & clock
  - [Wflow/src/config_structure.jl](Wflow/src/config_structure.jl#L1-L120) and [Wflow/src/config_init.jl](Wflow/src/config_init.jl#L1-L120) define `Config` types, defaults, and initialization helpers used by `BMI.initialize`.
  - `Clock` type in [Wflow/src/Wflow.jl](Wflow/src/Wflow.jl#L10-L80) encapsulates simulation time, iteration, and `dt`.


## 3. IO and dataset access

- [Wflow/src/io.jl](Wflow/src/io.jl#L1-L120)
  - Implements `NCReader` and `NCWriter` helpers; functions like `read_x_axis`, `read_y_axis`, `write_netcdf_timestep`, and `open/close` dataset helpers used by BMI and `run!`.

- Readers and writers are stored on the `Model` as `reader` and `writer` fields and used by `run_timestep!` and BMI grid functions.


## 4. Domain, network and indices

- [Wflow/src/domain.jl](Wflow/src/domain.jl#L1-L120)
  - Defines `Domain` and helpers such as `active_indices(domain, key)` and index maps between 1D internal arrays and 2D spatial coordinates.
  - BMI relies on `active_indices(...)` to compute node counts and to slice internal arrays for BMI exchange. See [bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L120-L220).

- [Wflow/src/network.jl](Wflow/src/network.jl#L1-L120) and routing submodules
  - Graph-based connectivity, adjacent-node tables, and edge indices used by BMI `get_grid_edge_nodes` and routing code.


## 5. Routing and land models

- Routing core: [Wflow/src/routing/routing.jl](Wflow/src/routing/routing.jl#L1-L120) and many `routing/*` submodules
  - Implements `Routing` abstract and concrete routing models (river, overland, subsurface). Routing exposes property lenses used by BMI `grid_element_type` logic.

- Land and hydrology: [Wflow/src/sbm.jl](Wflow/src/sbm.jl#L1-L120), [Wflow/src/sbm_model.jl](Wflow/src/sbm_model.jl#L1-L120)
  - Soil/land vertical processes and `LandHydrologySBM` implementations; standard-name mappings for soil-layer variables that BMI recognizes.


## 6. Standard-name metadata and variable lenses

- Standard-name modules under [Wflow/src/standard_name/](Wflow/src/standard_name/)
  - Provide mappings from human/standard names to `PropertyLens` accessors into `Model` fields.
  - BMI uses `get_metadata(name; model)` and lenses to obtain references to internal arrays for `get_value_ptr` and `set_value`.


## 7. State, mass-balance, and output

- [Wflow/src/states.jl](Wflow/src/states.jl#L1-L120) — state extraction/restoration and `set_states!`/`extract_required_states` helpers used by `load_state`/`save_state`.
- [Wflow/src/mass_balance.jl](Wflow/src/mass_balance.jl#L1-L120) — mass balance bookkeeping used during `run_timestep!`.
- [Wflow/src/io.jl](Wflow/src/io.jl#L1-L120) — output NetCDF writing helpers.


## 8. Call/Dependency sketch (high-level)

- `Config` (from TOML) → `Model(config)` → includes `domain`, `reader`, `writer`, `routing`, `land`.
- `BMI.initialize` → constructs `Config` and `Model` and calls `load_fixed_forcing!`.
- `run_timestep!` (Wflow) / `BMI.update` (BMI) → `advance!(clock)` → `load_dynamic_input!` → `storage_prev!` → `update_model!` (routing+land) → `compute_mass_balance!` → `write_output`.
- BMI variable access: BMI name → `get_metadata(name, model)` → lens → `lens(model)` → slice using `active_indices(domain, key)` → return view to caller.


## 9. Where to look next (files to open)

- BMI adapter: [Wflow/src/bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L1-L800)
- Core orchestrator: [Wflow/src/Wflow.jl](Wflow/src/Wflow.jl#L1-L400)
- IO: [Wflow/src/io.jl](Wflow/src/io.jl#L1-L240)
- Domain/indexing: [Wflow/src/domain.jl](Wflow/src/domain.jl#L1-L320)
- Standard-name maps: [Wflow/src/standard_name/standard_name_utils.jl](Wflow/src/standard_name/standard_name_utils.jl#L1-L200)
- State handling: [Wflow/src/states.jl](Wflow/src/states.jl#L1-L240)

## Modular overview

Below is a compact modular diagram showing high-level relationships between the main
components in `Wflow/src`. The diagram is intentionally coarse-grained so it remains
useful at a glance; file links following the diagram point to the primary source files.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  Wflow[Wflow.jl]
  BMI[bmi.jl]
  Config[Config / TOML]
  Domain[domain.jl]
  IO[io.jl]
  Routing[routing/*]
  Land[soil & sbm*]
  States[states.jl]
  Reader[NCReader]
  Writer[Writer]
  Standard[standard_name/*]

  Wflow --> BMI
  Wflow --> Config
  Wflow --> Domain
  Wflow --> IO
  Wflow --> Routing
  Wflow --> Land
  Wflow --> States
  Wflow --> Reader
  Wflow --> Writer
  Wflow --> Standard

  BMI --> IO
  BMI --> Domain
  BMI --> Config
  BMI --> Reader
  BMI --> Writer
  BMI --> Standard

  Routing --> Network[network.jl]
  Routing --> Subsurface[routing/subsurface/*]
  Routing --> Surface[routing/surface/*]

  Land --> SBM[sbm.jl & sbm_model.jl]
```

## BMI lifecycle sequence (initialize → update → finalize)

This sequence shows the typical calls a coupler makes through the BMI adapter.

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant Coupler
  participant BMI as BMI
  participant Model as Wflow.Model
  participant Runner as run_timestep!
  participant Clock as Clock
  participant Reader as NCReader
  participant Domain as Domain
  participant Routing as Routing
  participant Land as Land
  participant Writer as Writer

  Coupler->>BMI: initialize(config_file)
  BMI->>Model: BMI.initialize(::Type{<:Model}, config_file)
  Model->>Model: Model(config) → Model(config, type) (per-type constructors)
  Model-->>BMI: returns Model instance

  note over BMI,Runner: repeated during simulation
  Coupler->>BMI: update(model)
  BMI->>Runner: run_timestep!(model)
  Runner->>Clock: advance!(clock)
  Runner->>Reader: load_dynamic_input!(model)
  Runner->>Domain: storage_prev!(model)
  Runner->>Model: update_model!(model)
  Model->>Routing: routing updates
  Model->>Land: land/soil updates
  Runner->>Model: compute_mass_balance!(model)
  Runner->>Writer: write_output(model)

  Coupler->>BMI: finalize(model)
  BMI->>Writer: write_netcdf_timestep(endstate_writer)
  BMI->>Model: reset_clock!(model.clock, config)
  BMI->>Model: close_files(model)

```


Quick map (module → representative files):

- **Wflow core:** [Wflow/src/Wflow.jl](Wflow/src/Wflow.jl#L1-L400)
- **BMI adapter:** [Wflow/src/bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L1-L800)
- **Configuration:** [Wflow/src/config_structure.jl](Wflow/src/config_structure.jl#L1-L200), [Wflow/src/config_init.jl](Wflow/src/config_init.jl#L1-L200)

- **Routing:** [Wflow/src/routing/routing.jl](Wflow/src/routing/routing.jl#L1-L200) and [Wflow/src/routing/*](Wflow/src/routing#L1-L1)
- **Land / SBM:** [Wflow/src/sbm.jl](Wflow/src/sbm.jl#L1-L200), [Wflow/src/sbm_model.jl](Wflow/src/sbm_model.jl#L1-L200)

### Detailed `update` flow — SBM example

The following expands the `update` path (the most important runtime operation) with
the sequence of calls and the main files involved. This is presented both as a
compact flowchart and as annotated pointers to the implementation.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  RT --> RDR[load_dynamic_input!(model) \n(NCReader, io.jl)]
  RT --> STP[storage_prev!(model) \n(states.jl)]
  RT --> UPM[update_model!(model) \n(dispatch: SbmModel)]
  UPM --> LHD[update_land_hydrology_model! \n(soil/*, vegetation/*)]
  UPM --> RVS[update_river_storage_stage! \n(routing/surface/*)]
  UPM --> SUB[kh_layered_profile! / update_subsurface_flow_model! \n(routing/subsurface/*)]
  UPM --> SOI[update_soil_water_storage! \n(soil/*)]
  UPM --> SURE[surface_routing! \n(routing/surface/*)]
  UPM --> TWS[update_total_water_storage!]
  RT --> MB[compute_mass_balance!(model) \n(mass_balance.jl)]
  RT --> WRT[write_output(model) \n(Writer, io.jl)]
```

Annotated pointers:

- `run_timestep!(model)` — orchestrator in [Wflow/src/Wflow.jl](Wflow/src/Wflow.jl#L200-L260). Called by `BMI.update`.
- `advance!(clock)` — advances model time; clock logic in [Wflow/src/Wflow.jl](Wflow/src/Wflow.jl#L1-L120).
- `load_dynamic_input!(model)` — reads forcing for the current timestep using `NCReader` helpers from [Wflow/src/io.jl](Wflow/src/io.jl#L1-L240).
- `storage_prev!(model)` — snapshot/prepare previous-state bookkeeping in [Wflow/src/states.jl](Wflow/src/states.jl#L1-L240).
- `update_model!(model)` — dispatched by model type; for `SbmModel` see [Wflow/src/sbm_model.jl](Wflow/src/sbm_model.jl#L1-L120). Key internal calls:
  - `update_land_hydrology_model!` — vertical water processes (soil, interception). Implementations live under `Wflow/src/soil/*` and `Wflow/src/vegetation/*`.
  - `kh_layered_profile!`, `update_subsurface_flow_model!` — subsurface lateral flow processing in `routing/subsurface/*`.
  - `update_soil_water_storage!` — updates soil storage and runoff (see `soil/` files).
  - `surface_routing!` / `update_river_storage_stage!` — routing of overland and river flows in `routing/surface/*`.
- `compute_mass_balance!` — error/diagnostic bookkeeping in [Wflow/src/mass_balance.jl](Wflow/src/mass_balance.jl#L1-L200).
- `write_output` — `Writer` writes variables for the timestep; implemented in [Wflow/src/io.jl](Wflow/src/io.jl#L1-L240) and writer helpers.

BMI coupling specifics during update:

- `BMI.update(model)` (see [Wflow/src/bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L1-L200)) simply calls `run_timestep!(model)`; external couplers use `BMI.get_value` / `BMI.set_value` to read or modify variables between updates.
- `BMI.get_value_ptr` returns a view into internal arrays using `get_metadata(name; model)` and `active_indices(domain, key)` (see [Wflow/src/bmi.jl](Wflow/src/bmi.jl#L120-L320) and [Wflow/src/domain.jl](Wflow/src/domain.jl#L1-L200)). Writing via the BMI API (e.g. `BMI.set_value`) modifies those arrays in place; the next `update` will see and process those values.
